item: 6-1600 gh2-043-1 #14 — It is natural that … should / 직설법
add: It is natural that you should be disappointed at not passing the exam.
It is natural that you are disappointed at not passing the exam.
wrong: It is natural that you are delighted at not passing the exam.

item: 6-1603 gh2-044-1 #11 — Put the book back(흔한 차례)
add: Put the book back where you found it.
wrong: Put the book back where you bought it.

item: 6-1606 gh2-045-1 #1 — 화면에 안 나오는 조각('never found out.')이 가리키던 다른 꼴을 대체 답안으로
add: The exact time when the murder had been committed was never found out.
wrong: The exact time when the murder had been committed was never forgotten.
